question: Under which Article of the Constitution of India is the National Commission for Scheduled Castes established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 338**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (STs):

 
 
• The national commission for Scheduled Tribes (STs) is also a constitutional body in the sense that it is directly established by Article 338-A of the Constitution.
